implementation: Shared base64/UTF-8 recovery source decoder, driven synchronously by serde storage reads and cooperatively by authenticated browser API loading. The shared wire envelope uses the same metadata schema. Browser decoding borrows unescaped encoded fields, retains the fetch cancellation guard, validates the complete record and rejects account changes between yields. Local and remote Workspace filesystem adapters are unchanged.
